evidence.reason: The existence check trusts any directory matching the content-addressed target name and returns it without validating its manifest or artifact digests. If an earlier snapshot's untracked.tar was truncated while its manifest/token remained, an unchanged worktree produces the same target name; the fresh intact temp capture is then discarded and the caller receives success with damaged retained evidence. This is an ordinary correctness defect in retain's intended snapshot integrity, not a new requirement.
